name: knee-break-ankle-mobilization
instructions:
1. In an upright position, position a plate underneath the upper portion of your foot.
2. Keep your torso erect but bend the knees and allow the ankles to flex as your weight is shifted slightly forward.
3. Once you run out of range of motion in your ankles, extend the knees back to the start position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
